page_title: REI 2-1 REN | Reims v Rennes 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' 2 - 1 Fabian Rieder (Rennes) struck with a perfectly taken free kick from the edge of the box. He curled the ball straight into the top left corner. A technically perfect strike!
90+4' Rennes have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
90+3' Reims are ruled offside.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Warmed Omari (Rennes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
88' Samba Diawara has decided to substitute Junya Ito and he is replaced by Mamadou Diakhon (Reims).
88' It is time for a substitution. Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) is on for Oumar Diakite.
87' Bertug Yildirim (Rennes) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Yehvann Diouf pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
86' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
84' Sergio Akieme (Reims) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
84' Junya Ito (Reims) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
80' 2 - 0 Goal! Sergio Akieme (Reims) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes inside the left post. It's 2:0.
79' Junya Ito (Reims) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
78' It will be a substitution. Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) is ready to enter the pitch as Enzo Le Fee walks off.
76' Junya Ito (Reims) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
75' Martin Terrier (Rennes) and Ludovic Blas attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
73' Here is a change. Benjamin Bourigeaud is going off and Julien Stephan gives the last tactical orders to Fabian Rieder (Rennes).
71' Substitution. Thomas Foket (Reims) has come on for Abdoul Kone.
69' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yehvann Diouf, who smothers the ball.
68' The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
65' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Reims.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Amine Gouiri departs the field of play to be replaced by Ludovic Blas (Rennes).
61' Substitution. Keito Nakamura leaves the pitch and is replaced by Reda Khadra (Reims).
61' Julien Stephan prepares a substitution. Desire Doue is replaced by Bertug Yildirim (Rennes).
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Amir Richardson (Reims) is coming onto the pitch as Teddy Teuma cannot continue after picking up an injury.
58' Martin Terrier (Rennes) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
54' 38:62 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
51' Rennes force a corner. They send men into the box.
48' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Steve Mandanda no chance!
48' Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
47' Desire Doue (Rennes) commits a rough foul. Mathieu Vernice stops the game and makes a call. Reims are given a penalty!
47' Keito Nakamura (Reims) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' One of the players from Rennes times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Steve Mandanda makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Marshall Munetsi (Reims) inside the box and he drills a strike goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the target.
41' The corner from Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is cleared away by the defence.

40' Martin Terrier (Rennes) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Yehvann Diouf makes a great save to stop his effort.
39' The ball is out of play. Rennes will have a chance to score from a corner.
39' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) attempts to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but his effort fails to reach the goal.
39' Rennes win a direct free kick in a dangerous mid-range position.
37' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) is caught offside!

33' Keito Nakamura (Reims) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
29' The total number of attempts is 1:5.
27' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle and it's Oumar Diakite (Reims) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
22' Keito Nakamura (Reims) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
18' Neat passing move from Rennes in order to create new attacking opportunities.
14' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
13' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
13' Keito Nakamura (Reims) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
10' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Rennes was in an offside position.
8' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the right post.
5' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the corner.
4' The ball is cleared after Keito Nakamura (Reims) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The first half has started.
Rennes will kick-off.
Mathieu Vernice will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
